flaws.description: Swapped the numeric list literals assigned to the 'Vulnerable Employment (%)' and 'Informality Rate (%)' keys in the data dict, so the scatter plot now plots each sector's informality values on the y-axis and vulnerable-employment values on the x-axis while the axis labels, title, and legend remain unchanged.
Changed the Street Vending 2010 value in the 'Informality Rate (%)' list from 50.2 to 80.3, corrupting a single measured data point while leaving the table untouched.
